title.zh: 认识乐器的结构与声音

lead.zh: 按乐器家族与发声方式查阅结构、音域与演奏方法；MIDI 示例不等同于真实乐器录音。
lead.en: Explore construction, ranges and techniques by family and sound production. MIDI examples are not recordings of the instruments.

needs_sub.zh: 按同族比较最快：尺寸、材料、发声方式一变，音色就跟着变。
needs_sub.en: Comparing within a family is fastest: change size, material or driver and the timbre follows.

d.zh: 同一套弓法指法，尺寸放大一倍，声音就换了性格。
d.en: Same bowing and fingering, twice the size, a different character.

d.zh: 先看管形和簧片，再听音区：圆锥、圆柱与簧片决定了大半音色。
d.en: Start with bore and reed, then register: conical, cylindrical and reed decide most of the timbre.

d.zh: 按八音与演奏方式分组：吹、拉、弹、打，各有自己的声音逻辑。
d.en: Grouped by material and playing method: wind, bowed, plucked and struck, each with its own sonic logic.

d.zh: 同名不同形、同形不同名，先看它在哪里被演奏。
d.en: Same name, different shape; same shape, different name. Start with where it is played.

d.zh: 从振荡器、采样与音轮看音色怎么被造出来，而不是只记型号。
d.en: Understand oscillators, samples and tonewheels rather than memorising model numbers.

d.zh: 声部、共鸣与唱法，是乐器分类里最容易被忽略的一族。
d.en: Voice types, resonance and technique: the family most often left out of instrument lists.

ladder_sub.zh: 先从结构解释声音，再用声音验证结构。
ladder_sub.en: Let structure explain the sound, then use the sound to check the structure.

d.zh: 材料、尺寸、共鸣腔，先决定它能发出什么。
d.en: Material, size and resonator decide what it can produce.

d.zh: 音域图告诉你它在合奏里站哪个位置。
d.en: The range chart shows where it sits in an ensemble.

d.zh: 对比同族：差别往往在起音和衰减，而不是音高。
d.en: Compare within the family: the difference is usually attack and decay, not pitch.

d.zh: 一件乐器在什么场合被听见，决定了它的曲目。
d.en: Where an instrument is heard decides its repertoire.

picks_sub.zh: 覆盖弦、管、弹拨、电子与世界乐器，读完能建立比较的坐标。
picks_sub.en: Strings, winds, plucked, electronic and world: enough to build a coordinate system.

why.zh: 西洋弦乐的基准，后面所有尺寸变化都和它比。
why.en: The reference for Western strings; every size change is measured against it.

why.zh: 88 键是所有键盘乐器的公共标尺。
why.en: 88 keys are the shared ruler for every keyboard.

why.zh: 结构、记谱与审美绑在一起的一件乐器。
why.en: Structure, notation and aesthetics bound into one instrument.

why.zh: 共鸣弦与可移动品，解释了印度音乐的音色。
why.en: Sympathetic strings and movable frets explain the timbre of Indian music.

why.zh: 一台鼓机如何定义一种音乐的时间感。
why.en: How one drum machine defined the feel of a genre.

why.zh: 马鬃做弦也做弓，声音和材料直接相关。
why.en: Horsehair for string and bow; material and sound are the same question.

trails_sub.zh: 同一族连着读，尺寸与材料的差异会变得可听。
trails_sub.en: Read a family in sequence and size and material become audible.

d.zh: 从小提琴到低音提琴，尺寸改变的是什么。
d.en: From violin to double bass, what size actually changes.

d.zh: 笙、唢呐、笛与编钟，各自的场合与音量。
d.en: Sheng, suona, dizi and bianzhong, each with its own setting and volume.

t.en: A short history of electronic instruments

d.zh: 从音轮到 909，再到复音合成器。
d.en: From tonewheels to the 909 and the polysynth.
